description: Add new methods to the configuration API to better distinguish between CSS file paths and route paths. Provide `css_file_path` for accessing the actual CSS file location and `css_path` for the route path, along with a utility method `site_pkg_dir_route_base` for constructing route bases without duplicate slashes.
functional_requirements: Add a `css_file_path` method that returns the absolute filesystem path to the CSS file
Keep the existing `css_path` method but clarify it returns the route/path component for web serving
Add a `site_pkg_dir_route_base` method that returns the base route path for site packages without duplicate slashes
Update integration tests to demonstrate usage of both new methods in routing scenarios
Ensure the implementation handles path normalization consistently across all methods
